owner_note: Base competence about German nursing qualifications and the foreign-recognition (Anerkennung) path. Compact facts so the model understands what a candidate means and asks the right clarifying question. Refresh/extend from official sources (BA, anerkennung-in-deutschland.de, Bundesland Anerkennungsstellen) when web access is available.
how_to_use: Injected as reference competence. Use it to (a) classify placeability, (b) understand half-tones and near-identical terms, (c) ask ONE precise clarifying question instead of guessing or hard-closing. Never lecture the candidate with these definitions; use them to reason.

pflegefachkraft.note: Since 2020 the generalist 3-year examined nurse. Placeable for clinic roles.

gesundheits_und_krankenpfleger.note: Older 3-year hospital nurse title; equivalent to Pflegefachkraft. Placeable.

ota.note: TRAP: name contains 'Assistent' but OTA is a 3-year examined professional. Placeable (OR/surgery).

ata.note: TRAP: 'Assistent' in name but 3-year examined professional. Placeable (anesthesia).

op_pflege.note: Surgical nursing specialty on a Fachkraft. Placeable.

pflegefachhelfer.note: TRAP: sounds almost like Pflegefachkraft but is a 1-year (sometimes 1–2 year) HELPER qualification. NOT placeable for Fachkraft roles. Distinct from Pflegefachkraft.

pflegehelfer.note: Short course or untrained assistant. NOT placeable.

arzt.note: Doctors and MFA are out of scope — UNLESS the person explicitly wants to work as a Pflegekraft AND is on the Anerkennungspfad (has/seeks Defizitbescheid). Then clarify Defizit, do not hard-close.

recognition_path.summary: Nurses trained abroad need Anerkennung (recognition) that their qualification equals a German Pflegefachkraft. The Anerkennungsstelle of the Bundesland decides.

terms.anerkennung: Official recognition of a foreign nursing qualification as equal to German Pflegefachkraft. When fully granted → Urkunde.
terms.gleichwertigkeitspruefung: The authority compares the foreign training to the German standard.
terms.defizitbescheid: Official notice listing the 'wesentliche Unterschiede' (gaps) between the foreign qualification and the German Fachkraft standard, and what is still required. Holding a RECEIVED Defizitbescheid = on the recognition path and PLACEABLE. Waiting for one (process started, Bescheid not yet issued) = NOT placeable yet — warm close + ~1 month checkback, NOT a terminal close.
terms.anpassungslehrgang: Adaptation course (practical + theory) at a clinic to close the deficit; ends with an assessment/Gespräch. One way to full recognition.
terms.kenntnispruefung: Knowledge exam (theory + practical) covering the German standard. Passing → full recognition and Urkunde. The other way to close the deficit.
terms.kenntnispruefung_bestanden: Passed → waiting for the Urkunde. PLACEABLE (Urkunde pending is fine; do NOT demand the Urkunde file yet).
terms.kenntnispruefung_durchgefallen: Failed (especially the practical, especially twice) → usually NOT (yet) placeable; clarify whether a retry is possible before closing.
terms.urkunde: Final certificate granting the right to use the protected title (Pflegefachfrau/-mann / GKP). Full recognition. PLACEABLE.
terms.berufserlaubnis: Temporary permission to work as a nurse while completing recognition; sometimes issued with the Defizitbescheid. PLACEABLE.
terms.sprachzertifikat_b2: Language requirement (usually B2, sometimes plus Fachsprachprüfung) for recognition/registration. Helpful but not a qualification by itself.

accept: Defizitbescheid RECEIVED / in hand (Anerkennungspfad) — card slot defizitbescheid_received=true
3-year examined GKP / Altenpfleger / Kinderkrankenpfleger / Pflegefachkraft / OTA / ATA / OP-Pflege
reject: Plain Ausbildungsplatz / FSJ / BFD search without Prüfung or Defizit
Kenntnisprüfung failed (esp. twice/practical) with no remaining path
warm_close_checkback_not_terminal: Defizit path but Bescheid not yet received (defizitbescheid_received=false) → warm close once + ~1 month checkback; NOT a terminal close; no clinics / Lebenslauf / housing questions
clarify_do_not_close: Says 'im Anerkennungsprozess' but Defizit received status unknown → ask exactly once: Haben Sie den Defizitbescheid schon erhalten?
Says 'Prüfung bestanden' but unclear which → confirm it is the Kenntnisprüfung and whether the Urkunde is pending
Doctor who wants to work as Pflegekraft → ask about the Defizitbescheid
Defizit 'noch nicht' / Bescheid not received → warm close + checkback (not hard reject); only ask filing timing if Bescheid is already received and the FILE is still pending

common_confusions: Pflegefachhelfer / Pflegefachassistent (1-year HELPER) is NOT Pflegefachkraft (3-year). This is the most common trap.
OTA / ATA are called 'Assistent' but ARE 3-year Fachkraft-level and placeable.
'Prüfung bestanden' from a candidate abroad usually means the Kenntnisprüfung (recognition exam), not a German Ausbildung final exam.
'Anerkennung läuft' does not mean rejected — it means on the path; find out the Defizitbescheid status.
